overview: A private habit and streak tracker with a live clean-streak timer, history and milestones, and an SOS urge-breaker screen.
features: Live clean-streak timer in days, hours, minutes and seconds
Relapse/Reset with a confirmation dialog and automatic history logging
Total clean days, milestone badges and streak history with trigger tags
SOS urge-breaker with a guided breathing animation, motivational quotes and coping tips
Three-tab bottom navigation: Dashboard, Stats, SOS
Private per-user data with dark mode support
